text:
Situation: Corvale General holds 256 units of valacyclovir hydrochloride at a burn rate of 15.6 units per day, yielding 16 days of supply.

Why (FDA record): The product label identifies Northwind Health Company, LLC (FEI 1831143) as the registered plant with a VAI inspection on 2025-09-26. FDA inspection 952157 classified the same facility (FEI 1831143, Northwind Pharmaceuticals LLC) as OAI with an end date of 2015-12-09. Subsequent inspections in 2018 and 2025 returned VAI classifications. As of 2026-10-21, valacyclovir hydrochloride is not on FDA's drug shortage list.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately 16 days. The product is not listed in shortage by FDA. The registered plant holds a current VAI classification. Alternative suppliers are available but require verification of manufacturing sources.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate Proficient Rx LP (plant VAI 2022-12-08) for immediate purchase; requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to request plant identification from A-S Medication Solutions, ASCLEMED USA INC., American Health Packaging, and Aphena Pharma Solutions - Tennessee, LLC; requires P&T committee approval before purchase.
3. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list daily; no additional approval needed.

Not recommended: Switching to alternative antiviral agents or changing dosing protocols without P&T clinical review.
